phrases.it: Versa {amount} {fund} ogni {dow}, purché il saldo sia superiore a {bal}.
phrases.en: Transfer {amount} {fund} every {dow}, provided the balance is above {bal}.
phrases.fr: Vire {amount} {fund} chaque {dow}, à condition que le solde dépasse {bal}.
phrases.es: Transfiere {amount} {fund} cada {dow}, siempre que el saldo supere {bal}.
phrases.de: Überweise {amount} {fund} jeden {dow}, sofern das Guthaben über {bal} liegt.

phrases.en: If {cat} of the last {n} exceeds {v}, send me {alert}.
phrases.es: Si {cat} de los últimos {n} supera {v}, mándame {alert}.
phrases.de: Wenn {cat} der letzten {n} {v} überschreitet, schick mir {alert}.

phrases.it: A meno che il saldo non raggiunga {bal}, metti in pausa {rule}.
phrases.fr: Sauf si le solde atteint {bal}, mets en pause {rule}.
phrases.es: Salvo si el saldo alcanza {bal}, pausa {rule}.
phrases.de: Außer wenn das Guthaben {bal} erreicht, pausiere {rule}.

phrases.it: Se {cat} del mese resta tra {pair.value} e {pair.second}, aumenta il versamento {fund} del {pct}.
phrases.en: If {cat} for the month stays between {pair.value} and {pair.second}, raise the transfer {fund} by {pct}.
phrases.fr: Si {cat} du mois reste entre {pair.value} et {pair.second}, augmente le virement {fund} de {pct}.
phrases.es: Si {cat} del mes se mantiene entre {pair.value} y {pair.second}, aumenta la transferencia {fund} en un {pct}.
phrases.de: Wenn {cat} im Monat zwischen {pair.value} und {pair.second} bleibt, erhöhe die Überweisung {fund} um {pct}.

phrases.it: Quasi ogni mese sposta {rule} a fine mese.
phrases.en: Nearly every month move {rule} to the end of the month.
phrases.fr: Presque chaque mois déplace {rule} à la fin du mois.
phrases.es: Casi cada mes mueve {rule} a fin de mes.
phrases.de: Fast jeden Monat verschiebe {rule} auf Monatsende.

templates.pattern_label: IF NOT GTE SUM_SPENT LAST_N_DAYS TRANSFER

phrases.it: Se {cat} degli ultimi {n} non raggiunge {v}, versa {amount} {fund}.
phrases.en: If {cat} of the last {n} stays under {v}, transfer {amount} {fund}.
phrases.es: Si {cat} de los últimos {n} no alcanza {v}, transfiere {amount} {fund}.
phrases.de: Wenn {cat} der letzten {n} unter {v} bleibt, überweise {amount} {fund}.

templates.pattern_label: IF LT BALANCE AND PAUSE ALERT

phrases.it: Se il saldo scende sotto {bal}, metti in pausa {rule} e mandami {alert}.
phrases.en: If the balance drops below {bal}, pause {rule} and send me {alert}.
phrases.fr: Si le solde descend sous {bal}, mets en pause {rule} et envoie-moi {alert}.
phrases.es: Si el saldo baja de {bal}, pausa {rule} y mándame {alert}.
phrases.de: Wenn das Guthaben unter {bal} fällt, pausiere {rule} und schick mir {alert}.
